✅ Correct Answer: A — Giancarlo Baghetti

📖 Explanation:

Giancarlo Baghetti won the 1961 French Grand Prix at Reims driving a privateer Ferrari 156 entered by FISA.

He defeated Dan Gurney in a slipstream finish by just 0.1 seconds, becoming the only driver to accomplish this feat in World Championship history.
